set-variable.doc:name: Validate Delhivery API Key

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var body = payload var status = upper(trim(body.statusCode default "")) var milestone = if (status == "PU") "PICKED_UP" else if (status == "IT") "IN_TRANSIT" else if (status == "OOD") "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" else if (status == "DL") "DELIVERED" else if (status == "EX") "EXCEPTION" else if (status == "RTO") "RETURN_TO_ORIGIN" else "EXCEPTION" --- { received: true, carrierCode: upper(attributes.uriParams.carrierCode), carrierEventId: attributes.headers.'x-carrier-event-id' default "", trackingNumber: body.awbNumber default "", shipmentId: body.referenceNumber default "", rawStatusCode: body.statusCode default "", normalisedMilestone: milestone, milestoneRank: if (milestone == "LABEL_CREATED") 1 else if (milestone == "PICKED_UP") 2 else if (milestone == "IN_TRANSIT") 3 else if (milestone == "ARRIVED_AT_HUB") 4 else if (milestone == "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY") 5 else if (milestone == "DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED") 6 else if (milestone == "DELIVERED") 7 else 0, eventDateTime: body.eventDateTime default null, facilityCode: body.scanLocation.facilityCode default "", city: body.scanLocation.city default "", state: body.scanLocation.state default "", country: body.scanLocation.country default "", latitude: body.scanLocation.latitude default null, longitude: body.scanLocation.longitude default null, revisedEta: body.revisedEta default null, remarks: body.remarks default "", statusAdvanced: false, notificationQueued: false }

when.expression: #[!isEmpty(payload.trackingNumber default "") and !isEmpty(payload.carrierEventId default "") and !isEmpty(payload.rawStatusCode default "") and payload.normalisedMilestone != "UNKNOWN"]

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { received: false, message: "Invalid or unsupported carrier event" }]
set-payload.doc:name: Set Payload

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var body = payload var status = upper(trim(body.shipment_status default "")) var milestone = if (status == "PICKED UP") "PICKED_UP" else if (status == "IN TRANSIT") "IN_TRANSIT" else if (status == "OUT FOR DELIVERY") "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" else if (status == "DELIVERED") "DELIVERED" else if (status == "EXCEPTION") "EXCEPTION" else if (status == "RTO") "RETURN_TO_ORIGIN" else "EXCEPTION" --- { received: true, carrierCode: upper(attributes.uriParams.carrierCode), carrierEventId: attributes.headers.'x-carrier-event-id' default "", trackingNumber: body.waybill default "", shipmentId: body.referenceNumber default "", rawStatusCode: body.shipment_status default "", normalisedMilestone: milestone, milestoneRank: if (milestone == "LABEL_CREATED") 1 else if (milestone == "PICKED_UP") 2 else if (milestone == "IN_TRANSIT") 3 else if (milestone == "ARRIVED_AT_HUB") 4 else if (milestone == "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY") 5 else if (milestone == "DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED") 6 else if (milestone == "DELIVERED") 7 else 0, eventDateTime: body.status_date default null, facilityCode: body.location.facilityCode default "", city: body.location.city default "", state: body.location.state default "", country: body.location.country default "IN", latitude: body.location.latitude default null, longitude: body.location.longitude default null, revisedEta: body.expected_delivery_date default null, remarks: body.status_description default "", statusAdvanced: false, notificationQueued: false }

when.expression: #[!isEmpty(payload.trackingNumber default "") and !isEmpty(payload.carrierEventId default "") and !isEmpty(payload.rawStatusCode default "") and !isEmpty(payload.normalisedMilestone default "UNKNOWN") and (payload.normalisedMilestone default "UNKNOWN") != "UNKNOWN"]

set-payload.doc:name: Set Payload

db:select.doc:name: Check Duplicate Event
db:select.db:sql: SELECT event_seq FROM shipment_tracking_events WHERE carrier_code = :carrierCode AND carrier_event_id = :carrierEventId LIMIT 1

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { received: true, message: "Duplicate event ignored", trackingNumber: vars.event.trackingNumber, duplicate: true }]
set-payload.doc:name: Set Payload

db:select.doc:name: Lookup Shipment
db:select.db:sql: SELECT shipment_id, carrier_code, tracking_number, current_milestone, milestone_rank, promised_delivery, estimated_delivery, order_id, customer_id, customer_email, is_delayed FROM shipments WHERE carrier_code = :carrierCode AND tracking_number = :trackingNumber LIMIT 1

db:insert.doc:name: Insert Tracking Event
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO shipment_tracking_events ( carrier_code, carrier_event_id, shipment_id, tracking_number, carrier_status, normalised_status, event_datetime, facility_code, city, state, correlation_id ) VALUES ( :carrierCode, :carrierEventId, :shipmentId, :trackingNumber, :carrierStatus, :normalisedStatus, :eventDateTime, :facilityCode, :city, :state, :correlationId )
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ carrierCode: vars.event.carrierCode, carrierEventId: vars.event.carrierEventId, shipmentId: vars.shipment.shipment_id, trackingNumber: vars.event.trackingNumber, carrierStatus: vars.event.rawStatusCode, normalisedStatus: vars.event.normalisedMilestone, eventDateTime: vars.event.eventDateTime, facilityCode: vars.event.facilityCode, city: vars.event.city, state: vars.event.state, correlationId: correlationId }]

db:update.doc:name: Update Shipment Milestone
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE shipments SET current_milestone = :milestone, milestone_rank = :milestoneRank, last_event_time = :eventTime, last_location = :lastLocation, estimated_delivery = COALESCE(:revisedEta, estimated_delivery), is_delayed = CASE WHEN COALESCE(:revisedEta, estimated_delivery) > promised_delivery THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE shipment_id = :shipmentId AND COALESCE(milestone_rank, 0) < :milestoneRank
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ milestone: vars.event.normalisedMilestone, milestoneRank: vars.event.milestoneRank, eventTime: vars.event.eventDateTime, lastLocation: vars.event.city, revisedEta: vars.event.revisedEta, shipmentId: vars.shipment.shipment_id }]

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { received: true, message: "Shipment event processed", trackingNumber: vars.event.trackingNumber, status: vars.event.normalisedMilestone }]
set-payload.doc:name: Set Payload

db:insert.doc:name: Store Pending Event
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO pending_tracking_events (carrier_code, tracking_number, raw_payload, retry_count, expires_at, carrier_event_id) VALUES (:carrierCode, :trackingNumber, :rawPayload, 0, DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 48 HOUR), :carrierEventId)

set-payload.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { received: true, message: "Shipment not found; event stored for retry", trackingNumber: vars.event.trackingNumber, pending: true }]
set-payload.doc:name: Set Payload

db:update.doc:name: Mark expired tracking events
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE pending_tracking_events SET expiry_reason = 'Expired after 48-hour retention period; shipment not resolved' WHERE expires_at <= NOW() AND expiry_reason IS NULL;

db:select.doc:name: Find Resolvable Pending Events
db:select.db:sql: SELECT p.pending_seq, p.carrier_code, p.tracking_number, p.carrier_event_id, p.raw_payload, p.retry_count, p.expires_at FROM pending_tracking_events p INNER JOIN shipments s ON s.carrier_code = p.carrier_code AND s.tracking_number = p.tracking_number WHERE p.expires_at > NOW() ORDER BY p.created_at ASC LIMIT 50;

logger.doc:name: Log Pending Event
logger.message: #["Retrying pending event: " ++ (payload.carrier_event_id default "NO_EVENT_ID") ++ " for tracking number: " ++ (payload.tracking_number default "NO_TRACKING_NUMBER")]

db:select.doc:name: Check Shipment Exists
db:select.db:sql: SELECT shipment_id, carrier_code, tracking_number, current_milestone, milestone_rank FROM shipments WHERE carrier_code = :carrierCode AND tracking_number = :trackingNumber LIMIT 1

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var body = payload var status = upper(trim(body.statusCode default "")) var milestone = if (status == "PU") "PICKED_UP" else if (status == "IT") "IN_TRANSIT" else if (status == "OOD") "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" else if (status == "DL") "DELIVERED" else if (status == "EX") "EXCEPTION" else if (status == "RTO") "RETURN_TO_ORIGIN" else "EXCEPTION" --- { received: true, carrierCode: upper(vars.pendingEvent.carrier_code), carrierEventId: vars.pendingEvent.carrier_event_id default "", trackingNumber: body.awbNumber default "", shipmentId: body.referenceNumber default "", rawStatusCode: body.statusCode default "", normalisedMilestone: milestone, milestoneRank: if (milestone == "LABEL_CREATED") 1 else if (milestone == "PICKED_UP") 2 else if (milestone == "IN_TRANSIT") 3 else if (milestone == "ARRIVED_AT_HUB") 4 else if (milestone == "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY") 5 else if (milestone == "DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED") 6 else if (milestone == "DELIVERED") 7 else 0, eventDateTime: body.eventDateTime default null, facilityCode: body.scanLocation.facilityCode default "", city: body.scanLocation.city default "", state: body.scanLocation.state default "", country: body.scanLocation.country default "IN", latitude: body.scanLocation.latitude default null, longitude: body.scanLocation.longitude default null, revisedEta: body.revisedEta default null, remarks: body.remarks default "", statusAdvanced: false, notificationQueued: false }

%dw 2.0 output application/json var body = payload var status = upper(trim(body.shipment_status default "")) var milestone = if (status == "PICKED UP") "PICKED_UP" else if (status == "IN TRANSIT") "IN_TRANSIT" else if (status == "OUT FOR DELIVERY") "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY" else if (status == "DELIVERED") "DELIVERED" else if (status == "EXCEPTION") "EXCEPTION" else if (status == "RTO") "RETURN_TO_ORIGIN" else "EXCEPTION" --- { received: true, carrierCode: upper(vars.pendingEvent.carrier_code), carrierEventId: vars.pendingEvent.carrier_event_id default "", trackingNumber: body.waybill default "", shipmentId: body.referenceNumber default "", rawStatusCode: body.shipment_status default "", normalisedMilestone: milestone, milestoneRank: if (milestone == "LABEL_CREATED") 1 else if (milestone == "PICKED_UP") 2 else if (milestone == "IN_TRANSIT") 3 else if (milestone == "ARRIVED_AT_HUB") 4 else if (milestone == "OUT_FOR_DELIVERY") 5 else if (milestone == "DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED") 6 else if (milestone == "DELIVERED") 7 else 0, eventDateTime: body.status_date default null, facilityCode: body.location.facilityCode default "", city: body.location.city default "", state: body.location.state default "", country: body.location.country default "IN", latitude: body.location.latitude default null, longitude: body.location.longitude default null, revisedEta: body.expected_delivery_date default null, remarks: body.status_description default "", statusAdvanced: false, notificationQueued: false }

logger.doc:name: Log Unsupported
logger.message: #["Unsupported carrier in pending event; carrier=" ++ ((vars.pendingEvent.carrier_code default "UNKNOWN") as String) ++ "; pendingSeq=" ++ ((vars.pendingEvent.pending_seq default "UNKNOWN") as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Shipment Missing During Retry
logger.message: #["Shipment lookup returned no result during retry; carrier=" ++ ((vars.pendingEvent.carrier_code default "UNKNOWN") as String) ++ "; trackingNumber=" ++ ((vars.pendingEvent.tracking_number default "UNKNOWN") as String) ++ "; pendingSeq=" ++ ((vars.pendingEvent.pending_seq default "UNKNOWN") as String)]

logger.doc:name: Log Pending Event Missing Tracking Number
logger.message: #["Pending event has no tracking number; pendingSeq=" ++ ((payload.pending_seq default "UNKNOWN") as String) ++ "; carrier=" ++ ((payload.carrier_code default "UNKNOWN") as String)]

db:select.db:sql: SELECT e.carrier_code, e.carrier_event_id, e.shipment_id, e.tracking_number, e.carrier_status, e.normalised_status, e.event_datetime, e.facility_code, e.city, e.state, e.correlation_id, s.order_id, s.customer_id, s.customer_email, s.estimated_delivery, s.promised_delivery, s.is_delayed FROM shipment_tracking_events e INNER JOIN shipments s ON s.shipment_id = e.shipment_id WHERE e.notified = 0 AND e.normalised_status IN ( 'PICKED_UP', 'OUT_FOR_DELIVERY', 'DELIVERY_ATTEMPTED', 'DELIVERED', 'RETURNED', 'EXCEPTION' ) ORDER BY e.event_datetime ASC LIMIT 100

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var event = payload --- { correlationId: event.correlation_id, eventType: "SHIPMENT_MILESTONE_REACHED", eventTimestamp: event.event_datetime, publishedAt: now(), payload: { shipmentId: event.shipment_id, orderId: event.order_id, customerId: event.customer_id, customerEmail: event.customer_email, carrierCode: event.carrier_code, trackingNumber: event.tracking_number, milestone: event.normalised_status, carrierStatus: event.carrier_status, statusDescription: event.carrier_status, currentLocation: { city: event.city, state: event.state, facilityCode: event.facility_code }, estimatedDelivery: event.estimated_delivery, promisedDelivery: event.promised_delivery, isDelayed: event.is_delayed, customerFacing: true } }

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE shipment_tracking_events SET notified = 1 WHERE carrier_code = :carrierCode AND carrier_event_id = :carrierEventId

logger.doc:name: Log Consumed Shipment Notification
logger.message: #[output text/plain --- "Shipment notification consumed; correlationId=" ++ ((vars.notification.correlationId default "none") as String) ++ "; shipmentId=" ++ ((vars.notification.payload.shipmentId default "unknown") as String) ++ "; milestone=" ++ ((vars.notification.payload.milestone default "unknown") as String) ++ "; status=" ++ ((vars.notification.payload.statusDescription default "unknown") as String)]
#[output text/plain --- "Duplicate notification skipped; correlationId=" ++ ((vars.notification.correlationId default "none") as String)]
